stem: A worker repeatedly coughs and wheezes only during a dusty cannabis-handling task. What is the strongest Technician I response?
choices: Report the work-related symptom pattern through the workplace health/safety process and follow assessed controls
Diagnose the worker with a cannabis allergy
Give the worker any available dust mask and continue
Ignore it unless symptoms continue outside work
rationale: Cannabis workers can experience work-related respiratory problems. The technician should report the work-related pattern and use the workplace health/safety process rather than diagnose or improvise respiratory protection.
